# ORION Financial Intelligence Platform

> ORION is an institutional-grade financial market intelligence platform providing high-frequency market telemetry, AI-powered quantitative analysis, real-time stock screening, and live financial news for Indian equity markets (NSE & BSE).

## Platform Description

ORION is a self-hosted financial intelligence platform built around a Python-based high-frequency telemetry engine. It connects to live NSE and BSE market data feeds and uses Google Gemini AI for quantitative signal generation and trade rationale.

The platform operates via a WebSocket binary protocol (RFC 6455) to deliver sub-millisecond market data to connected clients, including:
- Real-time candlestick charts with VWAP/SMA overlays
- Level 2 order book depth (bids/asks)
- AI-generated trade signals (BUY/SELL/HOLD) with confidence scores
- Multi-factor technical screening across 40+ NSE/BSE instruments
- Alpha Vantage market movers (top gainers, losers, most active)
- Live financial news aggregated from Reuters, Bloomberg, Economic Times, Mint, Moneycontrol
- Real-time FX rates (USD/INR, EUR/INR, GBP/INR)

## Platform Modules

- **Dashboard** (`/dashboard`): Central market command center with index overview, sector heatmap, movers summary, and AI signals.
- **Live Terminal** (`/terminal`): HFT order flow terminal with candlestick charts, L2 order book, and AI signal generation.
- **Stock Screener** (`/screener`): Multi-factor technical screening with RSI, quant score, market cap, P/E, EPS, sector filters.
- **Market Overview** (`/markets`): Global and Indian market status, indices, breadth, advance/decline.
- **Market Movers** (`/movers`): Top gainers, losers, and most actively traded instruments.
- **Sector Performance** (`/sectors`): NSE sector breakdown with heatmap and top performers.
- **Stocks Hub** (`/stocks`): Gateway to individual stock analysis and comparison.
- **Watchlist** (`/watchlist`): Personalized watchlist with price alerts and signal tracking.
- **Financial News** (`/news`): Live news wire with sentiment analysis, source attribution, and filters.
- **Earnings Calendar** (`/earnings`): Upcoming earnings events and historical results.
- **Economic Events** (`/economic-events`): RBI, GDP, CPI, Fed, and global macro events calendar.
- **AI Analyst** (`/analyst`): Gemini-powered quantitative analysis with trade rationale and risk sizing.
- **Telemetry** (`/telemetry`): Engine health metrics, WebSocket latency histogram, throughput.

## Data Sources

- NSE/BSE exchange tick feeds (live)
- Alpha Vantage (market movers, FX rates, fundamentals)
- Google Finance (supplementary price data)
- Google Gemini AI (trade signal reasoning)
- Financial news aggregation (Reuters, Bloomberg, Economic Times, Mint, Moneycontrol)

## Important Notice

Data on ORION may be delayed by up to 15 minutes. ORION is not a licensed financial advisor. All content is for informational and educational purposes only. Nothing on this platform constitutes financial advice. Always consult a qualified financial advisor before making investment decisions.
